fragment-rung-321k-rows-size-lever-LB-M9.name: fragment-rung-321k-rows-size-lever-LB-M9
fragment-rung-321k-rows-size-lever-LB-M9.evidence: 0.185 = fraction of the FRAGMENT ceiling (0.7928) reached by the best learned set, best seed (kmer4 rho +0.1466 at N=20k). SCOPE NOTE: this criterion quotes the 0.941 TILE ceiling; this arm measures the FRAGMENT rung, whose derived ceiling is 0.7928 - do not compare the two fractions without saying which ceiling. VERDICT: the size lever does NOT move the question. Margin over GC: 20k n=2 mean +0.0288 (range +0.0168..+0.0407); 150k n=2 mean +0.0191 (range +0.0179..+0.0203); pre-registered bar 0.05 -> DOES_NOT_GENERALISE at both sizes, never approached. REAL SUB-FINDING pointing the other way: kmer6 alone DOES gain from size (mean +0.0749 at 20k -> +0.1172 at 150k), so 4096 features were data-starved; but it never reaches kmer4's 20k value and GC rises too, so the margin shrinks anyway. Runner scripts/glm_genomewide_oracle.py on restored GSE144621 (LB 321,123 / M9 318,457, full-decompress verified); reconcile PASSED, load_shared returned 297,868/297,868 == the committed n_shared. HONEST LIMITS: 2 seeds per endpoint, not this project's 10; 2 of 4 planned replication runs LOST when the external drive disconnected mid-run; kmer6 at FULL 321k is RAM-blocked (see constraint glm-fragment-rung-kmer6-full-size-ram-bound) so the asymptote is UNMEASURED; the Q1b peak-tile half is INVARIANT to --limit (verified in code: the single consuming site at :126 touches only the LB fragment list), so its identical rows across rungs are ONE measurement, not three.

orthogonal-modality-stack-promcalc-plus-.name: orthogonal-modality-stack-promcalc-plus-N-channels
orthogonal-modality-stack-promcalc-plus-.rationale: The incumbent best is a 2-channel rank-average (promcalc-plus-conv-rank-average-hybrid-150bp, rho 0.4254) that wins 10/10 seeds with a paired CI excluding zero, and whose SHUFFLED-CONV control HURTS (-0.1232, 0/10) -- so the gain is channel CONTENT, not the averaging. Whether that STACKS to 3+ orthogonal channels is untested here, and it is the exact shape of the published ESM2+GEMME+ProSST result (+0.056, 90.5% of proteins) that the 2-channel version already echoed once.
orthogonal-modality-stack-promcalc-plus-.kill_option_withdrawn: An earlier draft of this plan offered killing one of the unrun arms to reach a verdict. WITHDRAWN as something I can do: kill_arm requires the arm's OWN executed evidence and refuses redundancy reasons, routing a no-evidence kill to explicit user authority. Recorded so the option is not silently re-offered.
orthogonal-modality-stack-promcalc-plus-.verdict_consequence: The ceiling stays blocked:untried-arm while ANY arm is 'planned'. Reaching 'plateau' by declining to DECLARE a known-promising arm would buy a verdict through scope reduction -- the 2026-07-09 defect in new clothes.
